biggest_catch: Surveys are the main way to earn but qualification is demographic — you will be screened out of many, per-survey points vary, and at a few dollars per cashout the effective hourly rate is pocket change, not income.
catches: Survey qualification depends on your 'About Me' profile demographics; disqualification partway through is common (some providers pay partial points for disqualification).
Earnings are in points at 1,000 pts = $1.00; the minimum redemption is 3,000 points ($3) — low, but each cashout is still only a few dollars.
Third-party guides note points can expire if there is no account activity for 3 months.
Some offer-wall tasks ask for credit-card signups — read each offer's terms carefully.
Reward delivery is quick but not instant in all cases (official site advertises same-day cashout; app listings cite 24-48 hours).

c1.evidence: GrabPoints — real operating rewards platform (est. 2014, millions of members); official support knowledge base at support.grabpoints.com and official site grabpoints.com describe the survey rewards program.

c2.evidence: Official support article 'How does GrabPoints work?' states the concrete conversion and floor: 'We offer one of the lowest payout thresholds in the industry — just 3,000 points (equivalent to $3)' redeemable for PayPal cash and gift cards (Amazon, Walmart, Netflix, Starbucks). Official homepage states '1,000 pts = $1.00'.

c3.evidence: Official support article: joining is free; 'No fixed schedule. No downloads required.' No fee to earn or redeem.

c4.evidence: Official support article quote: 'We offer one of the lowest payout thresholds in the industry — just 3,000 points (equivalent to $3). Redeem your points for: PayPal cash; Gift cards from Amazon, Walmart, Netflix, Starbucks, and many more.'

eligibility: Free account; email verification required; complete the 'About Me' section for better survey matching. Available worldwide per the official site ('Trusted by millions worldwide').
notes: Official terms are concrete: 1,000 pts = $1.00 and a 3,000-point ($3) minimum redemption. Catalog headline '0' corrected: surveys pay a variable number of points each (third parties report ~130-2,500 points per task), cashable from $3 via PayPal or gift cards. steps: Create a free GrabPoints account and verify your email via the confirmation link.
Complete the 'About Me' section so surveys can be matched to your profile.
Open the Surveys section and complete surveys (Hot Surveys, Survey Walls, Survey Routers) — each is labeled with estimated time and points offered.
Once your balance reaches 3,000 points ($3), open the Rewards Store.
Redeem for PayPal cash or gift cards (Amazon, Walmart, Netflix, Starbucks, and more).
timing: Redeemable once 3,000 points ($3) are earned; official site advertises same-day cashout to PayPal or gift cards.
